answer.rationale: The situation mirrors memory_b2 (regional failover during latency degradation in primary region, traffic shifted cleanly, error rates recovered within minutes). The release cannot be rolled back per compliance ruling, eliminating rollback_release. Route_read_replicas (memory_b5) addresses read-heavy dashboard load, not write-path latency. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) protect against partner dependency failures, not internal write-path degradation. Adding capacity doesn't address the root cause quickly enough at 5x target. Regional failover directly targets the primary-region-confinined write-path p99 climb while preserving the security patch and settlement writes via clean traffic shift to the secondary region.
